AN ORDINANCE OF THE TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN, GEORGIA TO ESTABLISH A COURT TECHNOLOGY FEE APPLICABLE TO ANY DEFENDANT AGAINST WHOM THE MUNICIPAL COURT OF PINE MOUNTAIN, GEORGIA IMPOSES A MONETARY FINE OR SENTENCE OF INCARCERATION; TO PROVIDE AN EFFECTIVE DATE; TO REPEAL ALL ODRINANCES AND PARTS OF ORDINANCES IN CONFLICT HEREWITH; AND FOR OTHER LAWFUL PURPOSES

WHEREAS, the Municipal Court of Pine Mountain, Georgia (the “Court”) was established pursuant to the Town of Pine Mountain, Georgia’s (the “Town”) Charter and applicable state law, including, without limitation, O.C.G.A. § 36-32-1, et seq.; and

WHEREAS, the Town desires to establish and assess a court technology fee applicable to any defendant against whom the Court imposes a monetary fine or sentence of incarceration.

NOW THEREFORE, BE IT ORDAINED BY THE MAYOR AND COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN, GEORGIA, AND BY AUTHORITY OF THE SAME, IT IS HEREBY ORDAINED AS FOLLOWS:
1: association, corporation, partnership, or company against whom the Court imposes a monetary fine or sentence of incarceration a mandatory technology fee in the amount of $8.00. Said mandatory technology fee shall be in addition to, and not in lieu of, any other fines, fees, or penalties mandated by state law, local ordinance, the Court, or otherwise. Notwithstanding the foregoing, such technology fee shall not be imposed where the imposition of such fee would cause the total amount of fees and fines imposed by the Court to exceed the maximum amount of such fees or fines that the Court is authorized by law to impose.
2: the fee established herein shall be assessed for each violation.
3: fee account and shall be tracked and only be used for expenditures relating to improving, upgrading, replacing the technology needs of the Town. Funds collected pursuant to this ordinance shall be accounted for by the Town and shall be used for the purposes authorized in this Ordinance.
